statement: On SDL HIDAPI Wii, discovery marks MotionPlus present when either the active mapped extension identifier or inactive A600FE ID matches. Joystick opening advertises SDL_SENSOR_GYRO based on presence, not on the active mode. Thus an advertised/enabled gyro can coexist with MotionPlus mode NONE and no decoded gyro samples; W4 observed the symptom but has not shown the causal state.

applicability.revision: SDL 3.2.10, SDL 3.4.18 and SDL main at pinned October 2026 source commits; no retail Wii measurement
applicability.scope: evidence_role: consumer. Wii GetMotionPlusState 385-428, OpenJoystick 773-799, SetJoystickSensorsEnabled 860-877. Matches W4 advertised/enabled/zero observation, without attributing its cause.
